source_verification.title: Council of Europe: CEFR Companion volume (2020)
source_verification.verified: Opened the primary PDF and independently read the A1 overall reading and correspondence descriptors. They support rereading very short familiar texts and brief personal messages about practical arrangements. The local exercise target follows that direction.
source_verification.limitation: The source does not prescribe this project's word limits, multiple-choice counts or visual style and does not validate these exercises. No source exercise wording was copied.

author_doubts_decisions: Hoed, oren, staart, koffer and stof remain as concrete visual hook words. They are untested; short nearby sentences and the requested images support them. They lower simplicity ratings where appropriate without making a key depend on an unfamiliar word. No idiom or cultural explanation is needed.

The three times in kat-werkt and three rooms in beer-dokter remain acceptable for short messages that can be reread. Each question requires one directly stated fact with no arithmetic. Both receive simplicity four, with the density explicitly recorded. This is a reading judgment, not approval for similarly dense beginner audio.

The coat price needed repair: De jas kost twaalf euro now supplies the exact object-price relation in one quote. The collection sentence now states Friday directly, removing the possible Saturday reading of kunt.

The humour is ordinary visual play: a paper-eyed plant, unusual hat, large sock, toy duck, stuffed bear, fish-shaped cake, desk cat, suitcase seat and birthday dog. Keys never ask for a punchline or cultural knowledge.

All five requested 1-5 ratings are recorded per item with concrete fixes or generation constraints. They are editorial judgments; none certifies CEFR difficulty, exam equivalence or actual image quality.

The cake-board risk was resolved in the brief by removing the board. The visible-suitcase distractor risk was resolved by replacing koffer-les q2 with the explicitly stated lesson setting, then excluding all setting cues from its illustration. Cat/home leakage remains a render-stage inspection point.
